source.command: python -m pytest tests/test_dispatcher.py tests/test_operator.py tests/test_codex_adapter.py tests/test_antigravity_adapter.py -q

claims.claim: Added a single-use Dispatcher boundary that deterministically resolves the already-selected executor and owns exactly one native invocation for PRIMARY, REMEDIATION, and REPAIR; operator.py now delegates this responsibility without executor-specific dispatch branches.

Preserved Codex and Antigravity native mechanics and semantic contracts while leaving Runtime admission, leases, repository-state enforcement, verification, completion, failure, and artifact handling unchanged.
Dispatcher performs no canonical verification, evidence construction, semantic review, correction decisions, repository completion judgment, retry, fallback, reroute, or publication.

Added deterministic regression coverage for selected-executor resolution, exactly-one invocation across all execution modes, failure propagation without fallback, structural outcome preservation, and operator delegation.
